input_schema.description: The input schema defining the structure of function inputs.

anyOf.description: An expression evaluating to the output length. Receives: `input`.

output_length.description: The length of the output vector, or an expression computing it from input.

input_split.description: Splits the function input into an array of sub-inputs, one per output element. The array length must equal `output_length`. Each sub-input, when executed independently, must produce `output_length = 1`. Receives: `input`.

input_merge.description: Recombines a variable-size, arbitrarily-ordered subset of sub-inputs (produced by `input_split`) into a single input. Receives: `input` (an array of sub-inputs).

description: The 4 fields needed to validate a vector function's split/merge behavior.
